vehicle.name: Small Transporter
vehicle.notes: Cheap and nippy (10% faster), but only 24 cargo spaces.

vehicle.name: Medium Transporter
vehicle.notes: The all-rounder: 30 cargo spaces at normal speed.

vehicle.name: Large Transporter
vehicle.notes: 36 cargo spaces, but it lumbers along 15% slower.

control.name: AI Controlled
control.notes: No need to sleep, can drive 24 hours a day. Extreme weather won't stop the vehicle.

control.name: Driven by People
control.notes: Vehicle must stop 8 hours a day for driver to rest. Extreme weather won't affect the vehicle.

control.name: Remote Controlled
control.notes: Loses signal in extreme weather: every weather event costs an extra 4 hours.

engine.name: Truck Engine
engine.notes: Vehicle will have to stop 2 hours a day to fill up fuel.

engine.name: Jet Engine
engine.notes: Travel speed is double. Vehicle will have to stop 2 hours a day to fill up fuel.

engine.name: Battery
engine.notes: Vehicle will have to stop 1 hour a day to charge.

engine.name: Solar Battery
engine.notes: Free charging but slows to 50% speed in bad weather.

engine.name: Hybrid Engine
engine.notes: Faster than normal, stop 1 hour a day to refuel.

engine.name: Nuclear Engine
engine.notes: No need to stop for fuel. In a car accident there is a 5% chance the nuclear engine is damaged and the vehicle has to be repaired.

pollinator.name: Honey Bee Hive
pollinator.notes: 20,000–80,000 bees per hive. Bee numbers halve after day 30 of the journey. Extreme weather can kill bees.

pollinator.name: Robot Forager
pollinator.notes: 20,000 robots, 15% faster than bees, never age, no charging needed. Needs Robo-Pollinator Control. 10% chance of weather damage.

pollinator.name: Smart Hive
pollinator.notes: 15,000–60,000 bees per hive. Numbers only halve after day 60, and weather losses are halved.

pollinator.name: Robot Scout
pollinator.notes: 15,000 robots that work day and night (30% more pollination). Needs Robo-Pollinator Control and a charging station.

pollinator.name: Robot Pollinator
pollinator.notes: 20,000 robots, 10% slower than bees, never age and ignore weather. Needs Robo-Pollinator Control and a charging station.

other.name: Distance and Vision Sensors
other.effect: Without these, AI or remote-controlled trucks take 50% more damage in accidents.

other.name: Repair
other.effect: Repairs take 2 hours instead of 8, and the truck regains 5% health after every leg.

other.name: Navigation GPS
other.effect: Navigation prevents being lost. Reduces travel time by 10%.

other.name: Robo-Pollinator Control
other.effect: If not included all Robos (Foragers, Scouts and Pollinators) will not function.

other.name: Small Charging Station
other.notes: Charges 10,000 robots per hour. Robots that need charging barely work without a station.

other.name: Large Charging Station
other.notes: Charges 20,000 robots per hour, so charging stops are twice as quick.
